base_branch_rationale: Wave B consumes the wave A role contract, which is not on main yet, so it branches from the wave A branch.

owner_start_signal.detail: The owner set the goal to implement the whole cluster plan in batch order; this record bounds Batch 3 wave A.

implementation_scope.summary: Reference and tree relations on one table, a portable single-parent guarantee through a nullable tree_child_key, adjacency plus materialized path traversal with no recursive CTE, the three delete policies, a subtree move inside one transaction, and scoped traversal that counts what the caller may not read.

forbidden_files_note: OperationDescriptor and SyncOperationRuntime are forbidden on purpose: the freeze enforces the v2 policy at registration precisely so that neither has to change.
forbidden_behavior: changing the existing schema, record or version tables in any way
using a recursive CTE or any MySQL 8 only feature
allowing a second tree parent for the same child
allowing a cycle, a cross-scope parent or a cross-schema parent
returning a silently short traversal instead of reporting truncation
naming a record the caller may not read in a traversal result
adding a public HTTP, REST or MCP surface
changing larena/core, larena/access or any package other than larena/storage
touching larena.test or any live environment
push, release or deployment without a separate owner request
test_plan: Plain-PHP package tests in the existing storage style with an in-memory SQLite capsule mirroring the frozen shapes.
required_tests: a reference relation is defined, resolved and explained
a second tree parent for the same child is refused by the unique index, not only by the code path
a cycle, a cross-scope parent and a cross-schema parent are each refused with their own reason code
depth beyond 32 is refused with depth_exceeded
children read in order and ancestors read from the path with no recursive query
a subtree move rewrites the path and depth of every descendant inside one transaction and preserves sibling order
restrict refuses a delete with descendants, cascade removes the subtree, detach leaves the descendants reachable
a traversal beyond its budget reports truncated with the count returned
an ancestor the caller may not read is counted as filtered and never named
smoke_plan: Migration parity on sqlite and mysql, a three-level tree built and moved with restart readback of the paths, and the coverage report showing the relation codes as covered.

action_gate_summary.note: Re-run the action gate inside the core package repository at coding start.

stop_conditions: a frozen table shape, identity grammar, state set or reason code would have to change
an existing schema, record or version table would have to change
the workbench would have to change
a recursive CTE or a MySQL 8 only feature would be required
a file outside the allowed boundary would have to change
an unrecorded product or architecture decision is required
the storage package repository is dirty or not initialized
nonclaims: A launch record authorizes a bounded coding wave; it does not authorize push, release or deployment.
Wave B ships relations and the tree. Localized values and publication are waves C and D.
No recursive query is used anywhere, so the tree behaves the same on MySQL 5.7 as on 8.2.
